Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

officedown 0.4.4

Issues

  • The style of table captions made by flextable is now applied when its id differs from its name, e.g. the style caption of the default reference_docx, whose id is Lgende (#112). flextable writes an id guessed from the style name; an unknown paragraph style id is now replaced by the id of the style whose name gives this guess. Word was using the “Normal” style instead.

Changes

  • The unused external_img() call kept in the plot hook for package accessr is removed: accessr >= 1.1.4 no longer modifies the hook. Older versions of accessr fail in rmd2word(). The test checking this line was failing under covr (#154).

officedown 0.4.3

CRAN release: 2026-10-15

Issues

  • hook_plot_officedown.Rd has no usage, and a fix was needed to avoid a NOTE (seen in CRAN Debian check).

officedown 0.4.2

Issues

  • The new plot hook stays compatible with package accessr, whose rmd2word() modifies it.
  • Loading officedown in a document using another Word output format (e.g. word_document) no longer produces a file that Word can not open: data frames are printed as usual, and printing officer objects (such as block_caption()) stops with a message asking to use officedown::rdocx_document (#121).
  • Cross-references to sections (\@ref(section-id)) work again with pandoc 3.12 and later, where Word displayed “Error! Reference source not found.” instead of the section number. Section identifiers can now also contain _ or ..
  • Headers and footers of the reference_docx now appear on every page, including after a landscape or multi-column section (#127), and no longer disappear from even pages.
  • Landscape orientation set with page_size (e.g. orient: "landscape") is now applied even when page_margins is not set (#145).
  • Bullet and numbered lists now use the list style set with ul.style or ol.style, even when the reference_docx contains another list style with a similar name (e.g. new-ul and new-ul-old).
  • Data frames no longer disappear from HTML documents and other non Word outputs when officedown is loaded, for example in a Quarto project.
  • Cross-references and captions written in Chinese or other non Latin scripts now work on computers that do not use UTF-8 by default (#37).

Changes

  • Figure sizes set with out.width and out.height can use any unit (e.g. "10cm", "5in", "80%"), and out.extra adds other image attributes. A percentage is now relative to the width of the page text, as in other R Markdown formats, and no longer to the figure size. Figures wider than the page text are reduced to fit it.
  • The documentation now explains how to cross-reference tables (chunk option tab.id) and figures (chunk label or fig.id).
  • officedown now requires officer 0.7.7.

officedown 0.4.1

CRAN release: 2025-05-20

Changes

  • Default page size is now set to exact A4 format for Word documents
  • prepare paragraph styles management for officer > 0.6.8

issues

officedown 0.3.0

CRAN release: 2023-01-06

new feature

  • data.frame in Word now support chunk options tab.alt.title and tab.alt.description, used as alternative text for tables.
  • Document sections are set to NULL by default.
  • PowerPoint support for fpar() and block_list().

issues

  • fix usage of bookmark id containing underscore
  • update default values according to new default values of officer::opts_current_table().
  • dml background color bg is now read in R Markdown.
  • require officer >= 0.5.1 to avoid page breaking between sections

Internals

  • simplify/drop code with officer 0.4.5
  • add tests

officedown 0.2.4

CRAN release: 2022-03-07

new feature

  • emit a knitr chunk option is_rdocx_document set to TRUE when starting an rdocx_document. This will help with programing as it can be used to detect if in an rdocx_document context or not.

issues

  • bookmark only numbers
  • capture fig.cap.fp_text and not fig.fp_text
  • topcaption is now set to TRUE by default for tables as it is set by default in officer.

officedown 0.2.3

CRAN release: 2021-11-16

new feature

  • support for knitr chunk options tab.topcaption and tab.lp.
  • support for knitr chunk options tab.cap.tnd, tab.cap.tns and tab.cap.fp_text that let define prefix for auto-number table captions. Same with fig.cap.tnd, fig.cap.tns and fig.cap.fp_text for plots.

Issues

  • fix issue missing Word headers and footers.

officedown 0.2.2

CRAN release: 2021-04-05

new feature

  • Added the control of page dimensions; it is now possible to define the default section of a document.

Issues

  • set number_sections to FALSE when bookdown::markdown_document2 is used to avoid sections numbered twice.

new feature

  • support for knitr chunk option fig.alt and fig.topcaption.
